details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) One pipeline phase workflow (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, validate or orchestrate). Name the workflow in your answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B) A helper script under `scripts/`. Name the script.
C) Documentation (README.md, docs/ or an agents.d/ fragment).
D) Tests or CI (contract tests, the smoke canary or the release gates).
E) Something else. Describe it.
Q2: What does "better" mean for that part?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure. Link the run, log or error. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Cut cost or runtime (tokens, GitHub API calls, job duration).
C) Make it more reliable (fewer flaky failures or stalls, better self-healing).
D) Add a new capability or behaviour. Describe the target behaviour.
E) Make it easier to read or maintain (docs or clearer logs) without changing behaviour.
Q3: What result would show this issue is done?
Choices:
A) A specific test, check or workflow run that must pass. Name it. (RECOMMENDED)
B) A measurable target, such as a percentage drop in cost or runtime, or failure rate below some threshold.
C) A behaviour you can see from the outside. Describe the before and after.
D) No fixed criterion: a single small, low-risk improvement is enough.
